sets.relationshipLabel: a worker and the tool of their trade
sets.explanation: Cavers rely on headlamps and cave divers on guidelines — each role is defined by the gear that makes it possible.

sets.relationshipLabel: a season and the activity that belongs to it
sets.explanation: Swarming happens in autumn and hibernation in winter — each season triggers its own predictable bat behavior.

sets.relationshipLabel: a thing and a feature it simply has
sets.explanation: A cave has a mouth and a shaft has a collar — both are structural parts every such feature necessarily possesses.

sets.relationshipLabel: a broad category and a specific kind within it
sets.explanation: A stalactite is a kind of speleothem and a sinkhole is a kind of karst landform — each pair moves from general class to specific instance.
